front: Which is the highest dam in India, and on which river and state is it built?
back: Tehri Dam (height 260.5 m, earth-and-rockfill) on the Bhagirathi River in Tehri Garhwal district, Uttarakhand.

front: Which is India's highest concrete gravity dam, and what is its reservoir called?
back: Bhakra Dam (height 226 m) on the Sutlej River in Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh. Reservoir is Govind Sagar.

front: Which is the longest earthen dam in India / world, and on which river is it located?
back: Hirakud Dam (total length 25.8 km, main dam 4.8 km) on the Mahanadi River in Sambalpur, Odisha.

front: Which is India's largest artificial reservoir by water storage volume?
back: Govind Ballabh Pant Sagar, formed by the Rihand Dam on the Rihand River (a tributary of the Son) in Sonbhadra district, Uttar Pradesh.

front: On which river and district is the historic Nizam Sagar Dam constructed?
back: Manjeera River (a right-bank tributary of Godavari) in Kamareddy district, Telangana. Built between 1923-1931 by the 7th Nizam under Nawab Ali Nawaz Jung.

front: On which river is the Nagarjuna Sagar Dam, the world's largest masonry dam, built?
back: Krishna River (straddling Nalgonda district, Telangana and Palnadu/Guntur district, Andhra Pradesh).

front: On which river is the Almatti Dam (Lal Bahadur Shastri Dam) built?
back: Krishna River in Bijapur (Vijayapura) district, Karnataka (Upper Krishna Project).

front: On which river is the Sardar Sarovar Dam built?
back: Narmada River at Kevadia in Narmada district, Gujarat.

front: Which barrage serves as the primary intake structure for the Kaleshwaram Lift Irrigation Project?
back: Medigadda (Lakshmi) Barrage across the Godavari River just downstream of the confluence with the Pranahita River in Jayashankar Bhupalpally district.

front: On which river is the Mettur Dam (Stanley Reservoir) built?
back: Cauvery River in Salem district, Tamil Nadu.
